stationary_return_rail.scope: L-shaped reaction-rail geometry/interface required; not vehicle mass. Continuous guideway mass, joints and local cross-field behavior require independent design.

definition.attachment_hold: Propulsion band retention/dropinterface and transverse bracing unqualified; all magnet/core/cover/tray mass counted.
definition.magnetization: Tangential+x PM between negative/positive shoes then−x PM; two PM and two laminated shoes perperiod
definition.topology: Both broad faces free; no uncounted backiron or assumed fluxgain. Nonlinear2D field solved independently of lift/guidance circuit.

guideway_definition.scope: Magnetic return stock only; civil module must add actual crossmembers, fasteners, rail joints and maintainability. No beam, prestress or foundation acceptance.

holds: Nonlinear reluctance map uses a typical50Hz steel curve as a reversible DC proxy; measured3D force/linkage/loss/demag maps remain required.

Allocated cooling, retained equipment positions, joint flux gaps, dielectric design, tolerances and supplier quotes are not qualified.
Retained stock dimensions/holes are integrated exactly; unlocated equipment and crowd placements remain assumptions. Full equipped native CG/inertia is not accepted.
Complete3D lamination joint insulation/fringing requires native interference and field verification.
Guide-coil axial height75mm overlaps available80mm leg with5mm axial total margin; support/tolerance stack and coldplate routing unqualified.
The common lift coil needs a split/bobbin assembly before yoke closure; PM assembly needs a restrained fixture.
Cooling channels,120A connector derating, clamp fasteners and dielectric tolerances are allocated, not production drawings.

electrical_topology.guidance: two series-opposed return-leg coils link difference of branch fluxes
electrical_topology.lift: one coil links sum of both branch fluxes
electrical_topology.useful_flux_path: shared stem -> top fork -> vertical lift gap -> stationary L rail -> horizontal guide gap -> return leg -> PM bank -> bottom return -> shared stem

geometry_holds: Complete3D lamination joint insulation/fringing requires native interference and field verification.

The common lift coil needs a split/bobbin assembly before yoke closure; PM assembly needs a restrained fixture.
Cooling channels,120A connector derating, clamp fasteners and dielectric tolerances are allocated, not production drawings.

leakage.basis: Actual60mm fork-end to return-pole clearance;20mm facing vertical overlap.3D end leakage and cornerfringing remain unqualified.

stationary_return_rail.scope: L-shaped reaction-rail geometry/interface required; not vehicle mass. Continuous guideway mass, joints and local cross-field behavior require independent design.

propulsion_band.topology: Both broad faces free; no uncounted backiron or assumed fluxgain. Nonlinear2D field solved independently of lift/guidance circuit.
